description.value: Windermere Market is a neighbourhood convenience store in North Vancouver's Windermere Street area. For touring cyclists moving through the Lower Mainland, it offers a local stop for grab-and-go supplies in a residential pocket of the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as shop=convenience at 799 Windermere Street, North Vancouver, which supports a basic groceries classification. The website URL points to a Facebook page, but the fetch returned a temporary block page with no usable business content — effectively a fetch failure — so all amenity fields must rely solely on OSM tags. No phone number is present in OSM, and no address or contact details could be corroborated from the website.
concerns: Facebook website fetch was blocked ('Temporarily Blocked' error page); no business content could be retrieved, so amenities are unverifiable from the website.
URL was discovered with only medium confidence and could not be confirmed as the official business page.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible convenience store with an active OSM record and no indication of closure; suitable for the directory as a basic resupply stop for cyclists.
